I.value_zh: event.schema.json、ADR-0018/0015、TASK-005/006 的事件 stub、Project 状态、文件系统快照与现有测试。
I.value_en: event.schema.json, ADR-0018/0015, event stubs from TASK-005/006, Project state, filesystem snapshots, and existing tests.
I.notes_zh: 不访问 OS watcher 或外部文件系统。
I.notes_en: No OS watcher or external filesystem is accessed.

O.value_zh: Event 模型、12 值 enum、polling/state-diff、订阅 API、同步 emitter、去重、测试、snapshot、ADR、报告、归档、提交和推送。
O.value_en: Event model, a 12-value enum, polling/state-diff, subscription API, synchronous emitter, deduplication, tests, snapshot, ADR, report, archive, commits, and push.
O.notes_en: Outputs do not mean execution has occurred.

A.value_zh: 以四轮提交实现 events 模块、state diff、订阅与 poll_once、接入 boundary/failure stub、测试和文档收尾；但 12 个事件在 polling 与同步 callback 两条路径中的完整归属未被唯一确定。
A.value_en: Use four commits to implement events module, state diff, subscription and poll_once, integrate boundary/failure stubs, tests, and documentation closeout; however, the complete allocation of 12 events between polling and synchronous callback paths is not uniquely determined.
A.notes_zh: 原文同时称文件类为 11、列名为 8（实际列出 7），并称同步类为 5。
A.notes_en: Source calls file events 11, names 8 (actually lists 7), and calls synchronous events 5.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 发起；ME solo 执行；caller 显式调用 poll_once，host adapter 负责后台循环或 OS watcher。
P.value_en: ADMIN originates; ME executes solo; caller explicitly calls poll_once, while host adapter owns background loop or OS watcher.

R.value_zh: 第 4/7 抽象、四提交、12 事件类型、若干测试最低数量与跨 OS mtime ±1 秒处理；但文件类事件数在同一决议中出现 11、8 与实际列出 7 三种表达。
R.value_en: Fourth of seven abstractions, four commits, 12 event types, minimum test counts, and cross-OS mtime ±1 second handling; however, one decision gives three file-event counts: 11, 8, and an actual list of 7.
R.notes_zh: 不选择其中任一数值替代其他数值。
R.notes_en: No value is chosen to replace another.

V.value_en: ADR-0018, ADR-0015, TASK-005, TASK-006, TASK-008, TASK-010, event.schema.json, and v1.0/v1.x boundaries.

C.value_zh: A1–A12：模块、模型与 enum、订阅/poll、boundary/failure/session 集成、角色切换、去重、schema、snapshot、ADR、报告归档提交推送。
C.value_en: A1–A12: module, model and enum, subscription/poll, boundary/failure/session integration, role switch, deduplication, schema, snapshot, ADR, report/archive/commits/push.

B.value_zh: 不得新增 EVENT 文件 envelope、偏离 12 值 enum、引入后台线程/asyncio 自动轮询、持久化事件流、使用 OS filesystem watcher、破坏 TASK-006 测试、加入迁移段或 MCP 工具。
B.value_en: Do not add EVENT file envelopes, deviate from the 12-value enum, add background thread/asyncio polling, persist event streams, use OS filesystem watchers, break TASK-006 tests, or add migration section or MCP tool.
B.notes_zh: host adapter 责任保持在外部。
